title: Software Developer Intern- 2027 Glasgow Summer R&D Internship
description:
:

**Software Developer Intern- Glasgow Summer R&D Internship 2027**

**Glasgow, Hybrid**

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

**About the Program**

Join one of the most exciting student opportunities in technology and innovation!

Each year, SAS welcomes a select group of interns to join us for a 10-12 week summer experience. In 2027, we will be hiring **8 R&D Interns** in our Glasgow office across a variety of teams.

As SAS's R&D hub in EMEA, Glasgow brings together talented engineers, developers, and innovators who build technology used by customers around the world. As an intern, you'll work alongside experienced teams on real projects, gain hands-on technical experience, and contribute to solutions used by our customers from day one.

You'll also become part of a vibrant intern community that extends beyond the summer internship. Alongside your fellow Summer Interns, you'll connect with year-round interns and recent graduates who began their careers through the same program. Many have chosen to continue their journey with SAS, reflecting the valuable learning opportunities, mentorship, and career growth the internship provides.

**Available Opportunities**

For our 2027 Summer R&D Internship Program, we are hiring **Full-Stack Developers** and **Backend Developers** across the following R&D teams in Glasgow:

* **Model Manager**
* **Analytics Lifecycle**
* **Intelligent Decisioning**
* **Compute Engineering**
* **GenAI Platform**
* **Analytics**

Regardless of the team you join, you'll work alongside experienced engineers, gain practical development experience, and contribute to technology used by customers around the world.

**What you'll do**

As an intern, you will work on real releases for real customers under Agile and CI/CD methodologies, experiencing every part of the development process. You will be integrated into a product team from Day 1, allowing you to learn from the highest calibre of talented and experienced R&D staff. You can expect to:

* Design and implement new features.
* Work with product management, UX and UI designers to define and design new features
* Collaborate with development teams to draft technical specifications and designs
* Implement new product features
* Participate in code reviews
* Improve testing automation and integration into our testing and delivery pipeline
* Make a real difference – and get paid while doing it!

**Required qualifications**

* You are a penultimate year bachelor's student in one of the STEM Faculties.
* Strong communication skills – both written and verbal.
* You are available to start the internship in 2027 late May and continue through the summer for 10-12 weeks.
* You have good programming skills, in at least 1 modern programming language.
* You are familiar with basic computing concepts.
* You’re curious, passionate, authentic, and accountable. These are our values and influence everything we do.

**You are welcome here.**

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

**Additional Information:**

*SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact* *Recruitingsupport@sas.com.*

Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.

title: Software Engineering Intern (2027 Start) - London
description:

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees.

title: Graduate Product Engineer Opportunities 2027
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

**Your role in the team**

The Allstate Early Career Development Programme is designed to help you launch your career in technology. As a full-time Graduate Product Engineer, you will work directly within an Allstate Technology Solutions team, gaining hands on experience and exposure to high impact projects while helping to solve real business problems using modern technologies.  
  
You will contribute to the development of high quality, scalable applications and systems that deliver value for Allstate and its customers. Working across the full technology stack, you will gain hands on experience with a range of modern technologies and engineering practices, which may include programming languages such as Java, Python and JavaScript, cloud platforms, APIs, databases, DevOps tools, and front-end and back-end development frameworks used to deliver innovative products and solutions for Allstate and its customers.  
  
The ANI Early Careers training programme provides a structured introduction to Allstate, combining onboarding, business awareness and professional skills development. A key focus is building AI literacy from day one, with dedicated sessions on AI fundamentals and practical AI learning, alongside training in communication, resilience, decision making and customer experience. The programme helps graduates build early connections, understand the business and develop the skills needed to thrive in a technology-driven environment. After six months of various learnings online and in person, we ask participants to present their growth journey, reflecting on both their technical achievements and personal development since joining the organisation. Training and development activities during the programme will be delivered in person to provide hands-on learning and networking opportunities.  
  
Programme Highlights  
  

* Hands-on experience as part of an Agile technology team.
* Mentorship and support from senior leaders and technical experts.
* Opportunities to work with modern and innovative technologies.
* Exposure to real business challenges and customer focused solutions.
* Structured learning and development opportunities.
* Opportunities to develop your technical, professional and leadership capabilities.
* A collaborative and inclusive working environment.

**Key responsibilities**
------------------------

  

* Consumer Journey Advocacy & Domain Expertise: Contribute across the full technology stack, working with modern programming languages, frameworks, and cloud technologies.

* Outcome-Based Iterative Delivery: Help define product requirements, prioritise features, and collaborate with teams to meet goals.
* Design & Systems Thinking: Use design thinking principles to create user-centric digital products and solve complex problems.
* Impact & Influence: Foster a positive team culture, effectively influence stakeholders, and communicate with clarity.
* Key Performance Indicator & Performance Measurement: Track and measure key performance indicators to evaluate success and iterate for improvement.

**Essential Skills**

  

* All applicants must demonstrate they have a legal right to work in the UK for employment at Allstate. Allstate is not providing sponsorship for this program.
* Are completing by September 2027 or have recently completed (within the last 2 years), a practical, engineering-focused IT degree or related discipline, with a minimum degree classification of 2:1 or commendation.
* Have less than one year of relevant professional experience gained after graduation.
* Have strong programming and system design fundamentals.
* Are curious, collaborative, and passionate about building meaningful, high‑quality products.

* Applicants must provide a note of their average module marks to date or the classification they have been awarded if already graduated. **Failure to do so will result in withdrawal from the recruitment process.**

**As part of the recruitment process, shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend an in-person assessment centre in early November 2026.**

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

  

* This job does not have supervisory duties.

**Job Posting End Date: Saturday 31****st** **October 2026 [11:59pm]**

**#LI-PB2**

**Skills**

Software Development

### **Shape the Future of Insurance with Cutting-Edge Tech and a People-First Culture**

**Why join us?**  
Allstate NI is proud to be Allstate’s European Digital Centre of Excellence, a hub for innovation and engineering excellence. We’re recent winners of Best Place to Work in IT (100+ employees) and Best Use of Cloud Services at the Belfast Telegraph IT Awards, and we’ve been recognised for our community and sustainability impact with Platinum in the Northern Ireland Environmental Benchmarking Survey.

We’re a product-driven, cloud-first organisation delivering real outcomes through modern technology, a digital product-centric talent model, and a culture rooted in engineering excellence. Our teams work in cross-functional structures, guided by an outcome-based delivery approach that accelerates speed, agility, and value.

We also invest in you. At Allstate NI, your career growth matters. You’ll have access to our Continuous Learning Hub, designed to support skills development and professional advancement through tailored learning paths, certifications, and mentoring opportunities. Whether you’re deepening technical expertise or exploring leadership roles, we provide the tools and support to help you thrive.

### **What do you get in return?**

As well as receiving a competitive annual salary, our reward package includes:

  

* Corporate bonus scheme
* Pension scheme
* Annual performance-related pay reviews
* Life assurance and income protection
* Flexible working options
* Hybrid working
* Private medical and dental insurance
* Access to an employee assistance programme
* Discounted gym membership

Be part of a high-performing, socially responsible organisation where your work has purpose, and your growth is supported every step of the way.

title: Graduate Software Developers
description:
**Location:** Edinburgh and Bristol  
**Salary:** £36,000 per annum

*We maintain a flexible working policy to allow for hybrid working when appropriate. Teams typically spend around 60% of their time in the office, although this may vary depending on project and business needs.*

If you are an engineering graduate who has recently graduated, or is due to graduate next year, we would love to hear from you. We have exciting opportunities for 5 Software Developer graduates to launch their career within a world-leading technology company developing advanced software solutions for uncrewed maritime systems. You can be based in either our Edinburgh or Bristol office.

Working as part of a collaborative engineering project team, you will contribute to the design, development, testing and integration of innovative software solutions that are deployed by customers across the globe. You will be supported through structured development, training and mentoring to help you grow into a highly capable software engineering professional.

**Why Join SeeByte?**

This is a unique opportunity to join a world-respected company operating at the forefront of autonomous and robotic technologies. You will work alongside experienced engineers, researchers and technical specialists while contributing to software solutions that solve complex real-world challenges.

SeeByte offers an environment where you can develop your technical expertise, build meaningful industry experience and benefit from clear career progression opportunities within a supportive and innovative culture.

For more information about life at SeeByte, our employee benefits, culture and recruitment process, please visit our Career Site

**Main Purpose of the Role**

As a Graduate Software Developer, you will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, helping to transform customer requirements into high-quality solutions while developing your technical expertise and gaining experience across a range of technologies and projects. Substantial support, training and development will be provided to enable you to grow within the role and build a successful career in software engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, implement, test and deliver robust C# software solutions.
* Contribute to software design, development, testing and integration activities across engineering projects.
* Deliver work to a high standard while proactively identifying opportunities for software improvement.
* Work with colleagues to understand, analyse and break down customer and project requirements.
* Collaborate effectively with engineers, technical specialists and external stakeholders.
* Participate in code reviews, testing activities and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Develop knowledge of modern software engineering practices, tools and technologies.

**Key Skills, Experience and Qualifications:**

* Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or working towards gaining a degree in a relevant discipline in 2027.
* Ideally a focus on developing software using C# gained through academic, personal or commercial projects, though a background in other programming languages would also be suitable (Java, Kotlin, TypeScript)
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Good interpersonal and communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a collaborative team.
* Enthusiasm for learning new technologies and developing technical skills.
* Eligible to apply for UK Security Clearance.

**Desirable:**

* Knowledge of modern C# language features.
* Experience of XAML-based Windows UI development, ideally WPF.
* Understanding of software verification and deployment techniques.
* Familiarity with defect tracking and collaboration tools such as GitLab or Jira.
* Knowledge of Continuous Delivery frameworks such as Jenkins.

**You Will Stand Out If You:**

* **Deliver Results**: Are focused on delivering excellent outcomes for customers.
* **Collaborate**: Communicate clearly, respectfully and effectively with colleagues and stakeholders.
* Actively contribute to a positive, collaborative and inclusive team culture.
* Enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting others.
* **Adaptive Thinking**: Demonstrate curiosity, initiative and a genuine passion for learning.
* Take ownership of your development and seek opportunities to expand your skills and experience.

At SeeByte, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and supporting employee wellbeing. If you require any adjustments or accessibility support during the recruitment process, please reach out to people@seebyte.com

**Because of the nature of the work associated with this post it is subject to special nationality rules and is open only to the following nationalities since birth: British, EE, Switzerland, Iceland Norway, Albania, North Macedonia, Montenegro, Australia, New Zealand, Canada and Japan. **Join Osprey and help deliver some of the UK's most complex engineering projects**

**Who We Are**

At Osprey, we specialise in delivering innovative heavy transport and lifting solutions for major infrastructure projects across the UK and beyond.

With over 25 years of expertise, we work on projects that shape the future, transporting and installing critical assets across sectors including renewables, nuclear, defence, civil engineering, marine, oil and gas.

From moving a 4,000-tonne railway bridge to transporting 107-metre offshore wind turbine blades, our projects are often among the largest and most technically challenging in the world.

As a family-owned business built on long-term relationships, we're proud of our collaborative culture, engineering excellence and commitment to developing the next generation of talent.

**Start Your Engineering Career with Osprey**

As part of our 2027 Graduate Intake, you'll join a team of highly experienced Structural Engineers, Project Engineers and Senior Project Engineers, gaining hands-on experience across a wide range of specialist projects.

This is more than a graduate role. It's an opportunity to work on nationally significant infrastructure projects, develop innovative engineering solutions and build a rewarding career within a growing business. Our SOAR Early Careers Programme gives you everything you need to make your career take flight through a structured blend of technical, professional, and business skills training. Alongside fellow early career engineers, you’ll build the knowledge, confidence and network needed to accelerate your career

**Your Role**

As a Graduate Engineer, you'll support the Engineering team in developing safe, efficient and innovative solutions for heavy transport and lifting operations.

Reporting to a Senior Project Engineer, you'll gain exposure to projects from concept through to delivery, working closely with operational teams, clients and fellow engineers.

**In this role, you will:**

* Support the development of engineering solutions for complex transport and lifting projects.

* Produce structural calculations and engineering assessments.

* Assist with technical proposals and tender submissions.

* Create and review engineering drawings using AutoCAD or similar software.

* Collaborate with project teams to develop practical solutions that meet client requirements.

* Visit project sites and engage directly with operational teams and customers.

* Apply engineering principles to solve complex technical challenges.

* Ensure all work is carried out in line with Osprey's Health, Safety, Environmental and Quality (HSEQ) standards.

* Contribute innovative ideas and continuously seek opportunities to improve engineering processes and solutions.

**About You**

We're looking for ambitious graduates who are ready to learn, develop and make a real impact.

You'll have:

* A degree Ideally 2:2 in Mechanical, Structural, Civil or Construction Engineering.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

* Good organisational and time-management abilities.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

* Experience using AutoCAD or similar engineering software.

* A full UK driving licence.

* A positive attitude, curiosity and a genuine passion for engineering.

**What You'll Receive**

We believe in investing in our people and supporting long-term career success.

As a Graduate Engineer at Osprey, you'll benefit from:

* Competitive salary of £28,000-£32,000

* 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays

* Enhanced employer pension contributions

* Private medical insurance

* Income protection insurance

* Performance-related bonus scheme

* Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

* Cycle2Work scheme

* Employee Assistance Programme

* Ongoing professional development and CPD support

* Mentoring from experienced engineering professionals

* Opportunities to work across a diverse range of high-profile engineering projects

**Ready to Start Your Career?**

If you're looking for an opportunity to work on unique engineering challenges, learn from industry experts and contribute to some of the UK's most exciting infrastructure projects, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Graduate Software Engineer
description:
Location

Aberdeen, United Kingdom

Category

Engineering

Date Published

30/09/26

Status

Open

**About the job:**

Kent is looking for a Graduate Software Engineer to be based in Aberdeen.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make a difference and engineer solutions that make not only the UK’s energy security stronger but actively impact the way in which the world drives towards a net zero future?

Our Engineering & Consulting Software Development team works closely with our clients to develop high-quality software solutions that add real value to their operations. By combining high-end technical knowledge with modern software development, the team provides its clients with the tools needed to efficiently and reliably solve many of the Energy industry’s technical challenges, across a wide range of disciplines. As a graduate in our team, you will be working on intelligent and useful software to support some of the most challenging engineering projects, helping shape the future of energy. You will get involved in the full software development lifecycle, solving exciting challenges and growing into a high-quality software engineer.

**About our Graduate Scheme**

Our people are our power. At Kent, diverse perspectives and talents are the backbone of our strength. We’re building an environment where everyone, from engineers to scientists, from all walks of life, can thrive and reach their full potential.

If you’re passionate about making an impact and pushing boundaries, Kent is where you belong. We are a future-focused company, reimagining energy with ambition and innovation.

Our global graduate program offers hands-on experience, mentorship from industry leaders, and the opportunity to grow as part of a diverse and driven team. We’re building the next generation of leaders in engineering, science, and technology, and we want you to be a part of it.

**Application Process**

As part of the application process, candidates will be required to provide confirmation of the academic modules completed during their university studies. This information will help us assess the relevance of your academic background to the role. Please ensure that confirmation of your completed modules is submitted alongside your CV as part of your application.

**Application Deadline**

All applications must be received by **Friday 23****rd** **October 2026**.

**Recruitment Timeline**

Shortlisting and pre-screening of applications will commence in early November. Candidates selected to progress to the next stage will be invited to interview, with interviews scheduled to take place from late November to early December 2026.

**Eligibility**

Please note that candidates must have the right to work in the UK to be considered for this opportunity.

**Hybrid Working**

We follow a hybrid working model that combines office and remote work, with a requirement to be in the offices three days a week. This approach supports the development of a strong and effective team dynamic.

**Power the future with us. Unleash your energy**

**Skills & Responsibilities:**

As a software developer joining our Engineering & Consulting Software Development team, you will:

* Become an integral part of a growing team, collaborating with your colleagues to develop, deliver and support a variety of innovative software solutions that meet clients’ requirements within time and budget constraints.

* Get involved in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering, design and implementation, through to testing, deployment, maintenance and support. We use a lean and agile methodology, giving you the opportunity to grow into a well-rounded developer, and allowing you to have an impact on every stage of a project.

* Deliver bespoke software applications using a range of modern technologies and platforms, from desktop applications and services to web and cloud solutions and Microsoft Office automation. The team will help you continuously improve your programming skills, learn new things and keep up to date with the latest developments in the industry.

* Solve logical and algorithmic problems, review them with the wider team, and implement these solutions into working software features.

* Learn and adhere to our software engineering standards, procedures and best practices, and provide suggestions for continuous improvements.

* Build and configure test environments and carry out unit and factory acceptance tests for our developed applications.

* Produce relevant user documentation and deployment guides.

* Provide support to our clients, both external and internal, for our growing portfolio of software products.

* Help deploy software applications and systems and provide training to end users when required.

* Be part of an excellent working environment, collaborating with technical experts across various domains and disciplines to produce software of the highest quality standards.

Our technology stack is mostly Microsoft-based: we develop software using .NET and Visual Studio, primarily in C#, but also VB.NET for legacy applications. We use Windows Presentation Foundation (WPF) and legacy WinForms for our desktop apps, ASP.NET and Angular for web development, SQL Server and Azure for data. We also use Python for various data analytics or scripting solutions. You will also get to develop clever macros using VBA to help our engineering teams become more efficient and save time through automation. All of these will be supported by using Artificial Intelligence, particularly Large Language Models, to increase our development efficiency, so you will be gaining more experience with using some of the latest models.

In addition to the responsibilities listed herein, the employee may be required to perform other ad-hoc tasks as needed or directed by the supervisor or management. These tasks will be within the reasonable scope of the employee's skills, capabilities, and role within the organization. The intent of this provision is to allow for flexibility and adaptability in meeting the dynamic needs of the organization, ensuring that operational requirements can be met efficiently. All such tasks will be assigned considering the employee's current workload and with respect to their professional development.

**Your knowledge/skills, education, and experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science (or similar / related field).

* Experience in software development, preferably using .NET (C# or VB.NET) or Python, gained through work experience, degree coursework or self-study. Ideally, you will have used .NET, SQL in the past and have experience with desktop and web development (preferably with some of WPF, WinForms, ASP.NET MVC and WebAPI, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Angular, but not essential). We will help you constantly improve your skills and become a great developer, as long as you are passionate about technology, software development, and artificial intelligence, and willing to learn and adapt to the rapid pace of the industry.

* Understanding of software development principles and strong commitment to delivering to high quality standards, constantly looking for innovation and improvements, whilst futureproofing your work

**Communication:**

* Excellent command of the English language in both oral and written communication and skills.

**Behaviour/ Core Competencies:**

* Technically minded with strong analytical and logical problem-solving skills. A passion for solving difficult challenges, and persistence are desirable.

* Able to work in an agile environment, adapting to various domains and coping with uncertainty and changing requirements.

* Ability to work in a team, across a variety of projects and technologies and to prioritise workload, ensuring that quality and timeliness of deliverables is met.

* Creativity and strong communication skills for both business and technical audiences.

* A practical mind and being self-motivated, hard-working and reliable.

* We are looking for candidates who are due to graduate in 2027, or have graduated in the last 2 years.

**HSSEQ:**

The Employee shall observe the Health, Safety, Sustainability, Environment and Quality rules of the Company; it’s clients and the governing authorities of the host country.

We are committed to our diverse and inclusive community - a place where we can all be ourselves, thrive and develop. From day one, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, and employee networks to support staff from different backgrounds.

As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we value applications from all backgrounds, cultures, and abilities.

We’re a disability-friendly employer and can make adjustments to support you to perform at your best during the recruitment process. Please contact us confidentially at recruitment.uk@kentplc.com to find out how we can support you.

title: Java Developer
description:
***Please note this role requires 2 days a week at Mastek office due to the nature of work.***

  

**About the Company**

Mastek Limited is a global provider of enterprise AI, digital, and cloud services, enabling clients to achieve measurable and sustainable returns on their technology investments. The company has a presence in over 40 countries and a skilled workforce of close to 5,000 employees. Through its "Lead with AI" approach, Mastek integrates intelligence across its solutions and operations, enabling organisations to accelerate transformation using ethical, scalable, and domain-driven AI adoption.

Mastek partners with industry leaders including Oracle, Salesforce, Microsoft, AWS, Snowflake, and Databricks, serving key sectors such as Healthcare, Retail, Manufacturing, Higher Education, and Financial Services. With its core values of Trust, Value, and Velocity, Mastek empowers organisations to transform their business through innovative technology solutions while fostering a culture of collaboration, growth, and continuous learning.

  

**About the Role**

Mastek is set to deliver a high-profile programme for a central government department. The programme represents the next generation of the UKs biometric capability replacing and integrating with legacy systems and other government departments.

You will be part of a Mastek team in a multi-vendor project with a shared code base. As a Java full stack developer you will be responsible for designing and developing cloud native applications using cutting edge technologies.

The role requires in-depth understanding of the software development lifecycle and strong technical experience with an open-minded attitude and ability to rapidly adapt and learn.

  

**Responsibilities**

* Extensive server-side, hands-on Java 8+ development experience with strong Spring, Spring Boot & Hibernate
* Strong understanding of Microservice architecture
* Experience building web services and APIs on REST
* Strong understanding of unit & integration tests, following TDD / BDD
* Experience using test frameworks like Junit, Mockito, PowerMockito & Wiremock
* Experience and understanding of CICD pipeline of Docker, Jenkins and Kubernetes
* Experience with front end technologies: HTML, JavaScript, Jquery, Mustcahe Templates
* Led a team of Java developers to deliver high-quality software solutions
* Design and develop Java applications, APIs, and microservices
* Work collaboratively with other teams to ensure seamless integration of software components
* Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices and coding standards
* Actively participating in architectural & design discussions
* Experience with Agile development methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
* Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance to the team
* Take ownership of scrum team’s timelines and deliverables
* Proposing solutions to complex problems that are in the boundary of the existing system architecture
* Have an ability to communicate technical concepts to a non-technical audience.
* Understanding of all the agile ceremonies.
* Experience in Relational Database Management System (e.g. PostgreSQL)

  

**Desirable Skills:**

* Knowledge of Workflow/Business Process Management tools
* Experience with Performance and Monitoring tools: JMeter, Kibana, Splunk, Dynatrace
* Experience writing Shell script
* Understanding of Python
* Good understanding on AWS services (EC2, ECS, EKS, API Gateway and Serverless technologies)
* Integration Engine tools: Apache Camel and Active MQ for messaging, web services and distributed systems
* Public Sector domain experience preferable

  

**Qualifications**

**About the job**
-----------------

### **Job summary**

Discover a career in your hands at HMRC. Whether you're seeking purpose, growth, or a workplace that gives you a true sense of belonging, hear from some of our employees as they share their story about what its really like to work at HMRC.

Visit our YouTube channel to watch the full series and come and discover your potential.

At HMRC we are committed to creating a great place to work for all our colleagues; an inclusive and respectful environment that reflects the diversity of the society we serve.

We want to maximise the potential of everyone who chooses to work for us, and we offer a range of flexible working patterns and support to make a fulfilling career at HMRC accessible to you.

Diverse perspectives and experiences are critical to our success, and we welcome applications from all people from all backgrounds with the experience and skills needed to perform this role.

* Have you got a working knowledge of Java?
* Can you identify, triage and fix defects?
* Are you great at offering support and mentoring others?

If yes we would like you to be part of our outstanding team within Chief Digital Product Office, Digital Services.
  
  
Our purpose is to drive a customer centric approach to transforming services for HMRC Customers. Working closely with business stakeholders, contractors and suppliers - our aim is to drive digital innovation and to re-engineer services aligned to our IT, contractual and sourcing strategies and to deliver significantly improved digital services.

### **Job description**

You will be a key member of an Agile Scrum Team working across our Digital Application Support Service teams who are responsible for HMRC Self-Assessment digital service, ensuring users are able to get their tax right.

The team support customers, delivering change, enhancement and support for high-volume, business-critical HMRC digital service using Java.
  
  
Working as part of a scrum team you will have a key role in designing, building, and maintaining services that have a positive impact on over 12m users across HMRC.

### **Person specification**

Key responsibilities of this role include:

* Plan and lead development activities supporting legislative changes, service enhancements, maintenance and problem resolution within strict timescales.
* Put users first, translating user needs and user stories into effective technical solutions.
* Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the wider service architecture and support the development of others.
* Operate and support the live services you build, using monitoring and observability tools.
* Contribute to deployment activities and take ownership of production releases.
* Proactively improve service resilience, stability, scalability and maintainability.
* Support and mentor less experienced developers within the team.
* Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and engineering excellence.

**Essential Criteria:**

* Working as part of an agile software delivery team, leading on aspects of development work, providing guidance and setting development direction for more junior members of a team.
* Demonstrable working experience using Java 8 or newer and Spring Framework to deliver user-centred digital services.
* Demonstrable experience planning and leading development on related user stories.
* Experience of DevOps practices such as CI/CD (unit testing, TDD, Jenkins, Git, or similar).
* Evidence of taking ownership of risks and technical debt and ensuring theyre prioritised within the team alongside stakeholders.
* Problem solving and delivering a range of possible solutions, including through technical work and process improvement.
* Experience of evaluating data against business rules through rules engines such as Apache KiE  Drools.
* Operating a live service, using observability tooling such as Kibana, Grafana and Google Tag Manager, managing live incidents within an ITIL Framework.
* Knowledge of web security best practices, such as OWASP top 10.
* Experience of working with tools for API, performance, accessibility and security testing.

**Desirable Criteria:**

* Working knowledge of the Digital Application Support Services - Self Assessment application.
* Oracle Certified Professional Qualification.
* ITIL4 Foundation Qualification or be prepared to obtain it.
* Flexibility to work outside of normal business hours during Key Business Events.
* Working knowledge of GOV.UK Service Standard.
* Holds enhanced security vetting to SC level or be prepared to obtain it.
* Experience of working alongside Database Administrators (DBAs) to support in the diagnosis and resolution of data problems, sharing best practice on SQL queries.

**Further Location Information**

Please ensure that you only apply for a location that you are willing and able to work from, as we will only make one offer of employment. Any additional notes included in a Further Location Preferences (optional) field within the application form, will not be considered. Please be aware that you cannot change your location preference after submitting your application.

**Office closures**

For more information on where you might be working, review this information on our locations.

If your location preference is for one of the following sites, its important to note that these are not long-term sites for HMRC and we will require you to move to a new building in the future, subject to our location strategy and the applicable employee policies at that time.

These sites include:

* Telford Plaza, Telford - moving to Parkside Court, Telford

You will be given more information about what this means at the job offer stage.

### **Behaviours**

We'll assess you against these behaviours during the selection process:

* Changing and Improving
* Delivering at Pace
* Working Together

### **Technical skills**

We'll assess you against these technical skills during the selection process:

* You will be provided a scenario at interview where we would like you to demonstrate your experience and the approach you would take to the problem. You will be asked to talk through your approach and may be asked follow-up questions.

**Benefits**
------------

Alongside your salary of £45,544, HM Revenue and Customs contributes £13,194 towards you being a member of the Civil Service Defined Benefit Pension scheme. Find out what benefits a Civil Service Pension provides .

HMRC operates both Flexible and Hybrid Working policies, allowing you to balance your work and personal commitments. We welcome applications from those who need to work a more flexible arrangement and will agree to requests where possible, considering our operational and customer service needs.

We offer a generous leave allowance, starting at 25 days and increasing by a day for every year of qualifying service up to a maximum of 30 days.

* Pension - We make contributions to our colleagues Alpha pension equal to at least 28.97% of their salary.
* Family friendly policies.
* Personal support.
* Coaching and development.

To find out more about HMRC benefits and find out what its really like to work for HMRChear from our insiders or visit Thinking of joining the Civil Service

**Things you need to know**
---------------------------

### **Artificial intelligence**

Artificial intelligence can be a useful tool to support your application, however, all examples and statements provided must be truthful, factually accurate and taken directly from your own experience. Where plagiarism has been identified (presenting the ideas and experiences of others, or generated by artificial intelligence, as your own) applications may be withdrawn and internal candidates may be subject to disciplinary action. Please see our candidate guidance for more information on appropriate and inappropriate use.

### **Selection process details**

This vacancy is using Success Profiles , and will assess your Behaviours, Experience and Technical skills.

**How to Apply**

As part of the application process, you will be asked to provide the following:

**Sift**

Prior to applications being sifted candidates will be asked to complete an additional IKM assessment. Candidates will be sent details of the assessment once the advert has closed. This assessment is a pass or fail and only those who pass will be considered at the sift stage.

In the event of a large number of applications being received, an initial sift may be held on the CV.

**Sponsorship**

We have assessed this role against both Home Office and HMRC criteria and we are unable to offer sponsorship for a Skilled Worker Visa. This means the vacancy is not open to applicants who require visa sponsorship.

**The HMRC app can help you with your application**

Download the HMRC app now and save your National Insurance number to your digital phone wallet.

**How to download the HMRC app and sign up for an account**

If you have an HMRC online account already, sign straight in using your ID and password. If not, you can prove your identity by answering some questions or providing your photo ID.

Youll then be able to access the app quickly and easily by signing in using a 6-digit PIN, your fingerprint, or facial recognition.

You can find guidance for technical issues on GOV.UK: Technical support with HMRC online services.

**Merit List**

After interview, a single merit list will be created, and you will only be considered for posts in locations you have expressed a preference for. Appointments will be made in strict merit order in line with the set number of roles in each location.

**Criminal Record Check**

Applications received from candidates with a criminal record are considered fairly in accordance with the DBS Code of Practice and the Recruitment of ex-offenders Policy.

Complete the Assistance required section in the Additional requirements page of your application form to tell us what changes or help you might need further on in the recruitment process. For instance, you may need wheelchair access at interview, or if youre deaf, a Language Service Professional.

Prior to applications being sifted, candidates will be asked to complete an additional IKM assessment. Candidates will be sent details of the assessment once the advert has closed. This assessment is timed and is pass or fail; only those who pass will be considered at the sift stage. If you have any queries about the assessment, or require any reasonable adjustments, please contact talentacquisitionteam@hmrc.gov.uk

**Technical Support**

If you are experiencing problems that cannot be resolved by our help section, then technical support is available. You will receive a reply in 2 working days.

**Important information for existing HMRC contractual homeworkers**

This role may be suitable for existing HMRC employees who are contractual homeworkers. Occasional attendance to the office will be required where there is a business need. Please consider the advertised office locations for this role when applying and only select locations from the location preferences section that you can travel to.

**Terms and Conditions**

Customer facing roles in HMRC require the ability to converse at ease with members of the public and provide advice in accurate spoken English and/or Welsh where required. Where this is an essential requirement, this will be tested as part of the selection process.

HMRC has a presence in every region of the UK. For more information on where you might be working, review this information on our locations.

The Civil Service values honesty and integrity and expects all candidates to abide by these principles. The evidence you provide in your application must relate to your own experiences.

Any instances of plagiarism or other forms of cheating will be investigated and, if proven, the relevant application(s) will be withdrawn from the process.

Recording of interviews is prohibited unless explicit agreement is sought in line with the UK General Data Protection Regulations.

Questions relating to an individual application must be emailed as detailed later in this advert.

Applicants who are successful at interview will be, as part of pre-employment screening, subject to a check on the Internal Fraud Database (IFD). This check will provide information about employees who have been dismissed for fraud or dishonesty offences. This check also applies to employees who resign or otherwise leave before being dismissed for fraud or dishonesty had their employment continued. Any applicants details held on the IFD will be refused employment.

A candidate is not eligible to apply for a role within the Civil Service if the application is made within a 5 year period following a dismissal for carrying out internal fraud against government.

New entrants will join on the minimum of the pay band.

Please note that, if you are applying for roles on a part-time basis, the salary agreed will be pro-rata, reflective of the working hours agreed within your contract.

If you experience accessibility problems with any attachments on this advert, please contact the email address in the 'Contact point for applicants' section.

For more Information for people applying for, or thinking of applying for, roles at HM Revenue and Customs, please see link: Working for HMRC: information for applicants - GOV.UK.

  
  
  
Feedback will only be provided if you attend an interview or assessment.

### **Security**

People working with government assets must complete baseline personnel security standard (opens in new window) checks.

### **Nationality requirements**

### **Working for the Civil Service**

We recruit by merit on the basis of fair and open competition, as outlined in the Civil Service Commission's recruitment principles .

title: Senior Java Software Engineer
description:
Job Title

Senior Java Software Engineer

Location

Basingstoke, RG24 8UB GB (Main)

Job Description

**At Gist, we're proud to be part of the M&S Group, the logistics engine behind M&S Food.**

**From our distribution centres to our transport operations and support functions, we connect people, technology and expertise to ensure the right products reach the right stores at the right time.**

**As we continue to invest in our people, technology and network, there's never been a more exciting time to join Gist and help shape the future of food logistics.**

**The Opportunity**

Are you a passionate Java engineer ready to take on a role where your technical expertise and leadership skills can make a real impact? If so, we are looking for an experienced Senior Java/Spring Software Engineer to join our team and play a key role in designing, developing and supporting high-quality software solutions.

This role will see you being involved throughout the full software development lifecycle, from understanding requirements and shaping technical solutions through to development, testing, deployment, maintenance and support.

Alongside hands on development, you will have the opportunity to influence architecture, technology choices, code quality and performance, while mentoring other developers and helping the wider team continuously improve.

  

**What you'll be doing**

Reporting into the Head of Application Development you will be responsible for:

* Software Development: Design, develop, test, and maintain high-quality Java applications, delivering scalable and maintainable solutions that meet business requirements and security standards.
* Architecture & Technical Leadership: Contribute to system architecture, technology selection, and key technical decisions, ensuring solutions are efficient, secure, scalable, and fit for purpose.
* Quality & Best Practice: Champion engineering best practices through code reviews, automated testing and continuous improvements to code quality, performance, and maintainability.
* Mentoring & Collaboration: Provide technical guidance and coaching to junior developers, share knowledge across the team and collaborate closely with product, business, and technical stakeholders.
* Agile Delivery & Continuous Improvement: Support planning, estimation, and prioritisation within an Agile/Scrum environment, while identifying opportunities to improve processes, technologies, and ways of working.
* DevOps & Support: Work with CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices, support the resolution of complex technical issues, participate in an out-of-hours 2nd line support rota and travel when required.

  

In addition, this role will see you supporting the wider team with out-of-hour care 1 in 8 weeks, therefore we require someone who can be flexible.

  

**What we're looking for**

We are looking for an experienced software engineer who combines strong technical expertise with excellent communication, problem solving and leadership skills. You will have advanced knowledge of Java, including OOP, collections, multithreading and exception handling, alongside extensive experience with Spring, Hibernate and delivering production quality Java/Spring applications. A strong understanding of software design principles and development best practices is essential.

You will be comfortable working with modern development methodologies such as TDD, Agile and Scrum, as well as CI/CD tooling and technologies including Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes and Git. Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle and DB2, strong SQL skills and confidence working with data intensive applications are important, while knowledge of NoSQL databases would be advantageous.

You will bring excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to debug complex issues, identify root causes and develop practical, efficient solutions. Strong communication and collaboration skills are equally important, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly, mentor other developers, share knowledge and positively influence technical decisions.

You will also be well organised, able to manage competing priorities effectively and confident leading by example within a collaborative engineering environment.

**So, if you are a Senior Java/Spring Engineer who wants to do more than simply write code, someone who wants to influence, solve complex problems and help a team succeed we would love to hear from you.**

  

**Role details:**

Salary: Competitive Salary + Additional out of hours pay  
Hours: Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm  
Location: This is a hybrid role working 2-3 days at our Chineham, Basingstoke head office and from home.

  

**What’s in it for you?**

As well as a competitive salary, you'll benefit from:

description:
**About us**

H2 Cognitive Designs (H2CD) is a health technology company working at the intersection of cognitive science, clinical research, and large-scale digital assessment. We build platforms used to measure cognitive performance across clinical trials, occupational health programmes, and large institutional deployments in the UK and internationally.

Our clients include demanding and security-conscious organisations across healthcare, national institutions, and sectors where the performance and reliability of what we build matter. We have a rapidly growing portfolio of significant projects, and this role plays an important part in how we deliver them.

**About the role**

This is an entry-level engineering role. You will support major projects led by senior developers while learning and developing as a professional, helping to build and maintain web and mobile app-based cognitive testing and remote clinical assessment solutions for healthcare providers, academic partners, and related industries, working closely with senior engineers who guide the technical direction.

**Key responsibilities**

*Software Design and Development*

* Support the design, development, and implementation of full-stack web applications for cognitive assessment and remote clinical testing, working under the direction of senior developers
* Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code in Python, Django, JavaScript, HTML, and other relevant languages
* Contribute to the implementation of technical designs and strategies set by senior developers, with a day-to-day focus on execution
* Develop and maintain RESTful APIs for integration with other systems
* Implement responsive and accessible user interfaces for web and mobile platforms
* Submit pull requests for code review, and participate in reviews of your own work to support code quality and knowledge sharing
* Participate in all Scrum ceremonies and pick up tickets brought into the sprint

*Software Maintenance*

* Learn, maintain, and improve existing software codebases as required by customer or company requirements
* Ensure software operability across various devices, browsers, and platforms
* Monitor software performance and implement optimizations as needed
* Respond efficiently to reported software maintenance and defect requests
* Maintain accurate version control and documentation of reported issues and remedial actions taken
* Implement bug fixes and enhancements promptly

*Testing and Quality Assurance*

* Write and execute unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests
* Help identify software defects and escalate potential security vulnerabilities to team members for resolution
* Follow established industry standards for security and data protection in all code you write
* Apply best practices for test-driven development when appropriate
* Maintain test documentation and test coverage

*Professional Development*

* Take part in company-supported certifications and other learning opportunities as part of your ongoing professional development
* Stay current with industry trends, technologies, and best practices
* Participate in team meetings and initiatives to support business growth
* Contribute to research and evaluation of new technologies
* Receive mentorship from senior team members and share what you learn as your expertise grows
* Contribute ideas to technical challenges

*General*

* Work in line with company policies, including information security, data protection and quality management requirements.
* Take part in team meetings, training and continuous improvement activity.
* Carry out any other reasonable duties appropriate to the role, as required.

**What We're Looking For**

*Essential*

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
* Some experience building web applications, gained through internships, personal projects, coursework, or professional work
* Familiarity with the Django web framework (professional, academic, or project-based)
* Working knowledge of Python, HTML, and JavaScript
* Basic working knowledge of Git version control
* Familiarity with database design and management
* Willingness to work collaboratively in a small team, with regular guidance and mentorship from senior developers
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
* Good time management and ability to meet deadlines
* Clear communication skills and ability to document work effectively

*Desirable*

* Knowledge of healthcare IT systems or cognitive assessment tools
* Understanding of accessibility requirements for web applications
* Experience with PostgreSQL database management
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements in healthcare software (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA)
* Experience with Docker containerization
* Experience with test-driven development methodologies
* Familiarity with AWS or other cloud platforms

**Working arrangements**

* 37.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with flexible working hours.
* Hybrid working, with 2-3 days per week in our Central London office (Elephant and Castle SE1)
* Occasional out-of-hours work may be required to meet business demands.
* Must follow appropriate security measures in line with company security policy.

**What we offer**

* Salary: £45,000 per annum
* 30 days’ annual leave, plus bank holidays.
* Workplace pension scheme with a 3% employer contribution and 5% employee contribution.
* Salary sacrifice electric car scheme.
* Flexible working hours.
* Eye care vouchers.

Successful candidates must obtain BPSS clearance before starting. Higher-level clearance (for example SC or higher) is likely to be needed as we take on further contracts, and continued employment depends on getting and keeping the required clearance. For more information, visit GOV.UK: National security vetting clearance levels.

This role is subject to successful completion of a 3-month probationary period.

**How to apply**

To apply, please submit your CV and a short cover letter explaining your interest in the role and your relevant experience.

Informal enquiries: hr@h2cd.co.uk

In this role, you will be part of one of our technical teams that sit within the Digital Practice team within the Digital, Data and Technology (DDaT) directorate.

You will be responsible for developing software to meet user needs following best practice guidelines and helping to improve those guidelines. You will be able to write clean. secure and well-tested code following clear peer review processes within an agile or waterfall framework depending on the needs of the project. You will support colleagues as part of a collaborative DDaT directorate as well as operating as a partner to the wider Charity Commission to support the achievement of the shared goals, objectives and delivering a successful Commission strategy.

You will have the ability to coach and mentor junior colleagues and help build the capability of the team. You will also be able to operate and maintain Charity Commission systems, identifying issues in production while meeting the Government Service Standard and the Technology Code of Practice.

### **Job description**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Availability and capacity management -** Ensuring services are available with as little downtime or disruption as possible, and that we have sufficient resources to support emerging business needs. You will, manage service components to ensure they meet business needs and key performance indicators (KPIs)

**Development process optimisation** - Ensuring your processes are accurately defined and capture the most efficient way to complete a task by monitoring modified procedures. You will:

* Explain the importance of developing process efficiency and the common ways in which processes are optimised.
* Support specific activities to improve development processes.
* Identify obvious deficiencies

**Information security -** Maintaining the security, confidentiality and integrity of information. You will, design solutions and services with security controls included, specifically engineered to mitigate security threats.

**Modern development standards -** Using the latest technologies and best practices to improve the quality of the software development process. You will, apply modern development standards and support others in applying them

**Programming and build (software engineering) ** Collaborate with others when necessary to review specifications use the agreed specifications to design, code, test and document programs or scripts of medium-to-high complexity, using the right standards and tools

**Prototyping -** Exploring, testing and sharing different concepts before committing to the final design. You will approach prototyping as a team activity, actively soliciting prototypes and testing with others. Establish design patterns and iterate them by using a variety of prototyping methods and choose the most appropriate

**Service support -** Fixing service faults and maintaining the underlying infrastructure, ensuring processes are in place to keep the service running efficiently. You will, help fix service faults following agreed procedures carry out maintenance tasks on service support infrastructure

**Systems design -** Creating the specification and design of systems to meet defined business needs. You will, translate logical designs into physical designs

* produce detailed designs
* effectively document all work using required standards, methods and tools, including prototyping tools where appropriate
* design systems characterised by managed levels of risk, manageable business and technical complexity, and meaningful impact
* work with well understood technology and identify appropriate patterns

**Systems integration -** Identifying points of connection between different systems and processes, or opportunities to combine them, and designing how the components communicate.

* build and test simple interfaces between systems
* work on more complex integration as part of a wider team

**User focus -** Understanding the user needs to develop a detailed understanding of the problems that need to be solved. You will, collaborate with user researchers and can represent users internally

* explain the difference between user needs and the desires of the user
* champion user research to focus on all users
* prioritise and define approaches to understand the user story, guiding others in doing so, offer recommendations on the best tools and methods to use

title: Software & Hardware Developer (C# / .NET / IoT)
description:
**WE KNOW THIS IS A LONG JOB AD, SO HERE'S THE TL;DR:**

We're looking for a practical technical generalist who likes building things.

A lot of the job is C#/.NET, SQL, internal systems, dashboards and integrations, but those systems connect to real machinery, scanners, printers, sensors, GPS trackers, Android handhelds and hardware we build ourselves.

You do not need to already be a professional developer. If you work in IT support, infrastructure, sysadmin or another technical role and already code, script, automate or build electronics projects in your own time, we want to hear from you.

You'll get broad exposure, direct access to the technical lead, plenty of autonomy as you develop, and the chance to work on everything from agentic AI development to ESP32s, computer vision, 3D printing and industrial integrations.

*£29,000 to £34,000 DOE | Ramsgate | Primarily on-site*

**THE ROLE**

We are looking for a practical, curious and technically minded person to join our small in-house technical team.

EPCC is a garment printing, fulfilment and e-commerce business, and a large part of our operation is powered by systems we design and build ourselves.

A lot of the day-to-day work is software development, writing software to run our internal CRM, dashboards, online ordering systems, production tools, artwork proofing, warehouse systems and integrations.

But these are rarely isolated, spreadsheet-style CRUD applications.

Our software connects directly to the physical operation of the business: production machinery, barcode scanners, printers, Android handhelds, shipping carriers, sensors and devices we have built ourselves.

One day you might be building a C# feature or investigating a SQL problem. The next you could be wiring an ESP32, soldering a sensor, 3D-printing an enclosure or testing a prototype on the warehouse floor.

**WHO YOU ARE**

We are deliberately open to people from technical backgrounds such as:

* IT support
* Systems administration
* Infrastructure
* Networking
* Electronics
* Technical support
* Junior software development

If you write scripts, automate tasks, build applications, run a homelab, work with Arduino or ESP32 boards, create electronics projects, or generally spend your own time making technology do useful things, we want to hear about it.

**Personal projects count.**

If you work in IT support but have GitHub projects, an ESP32, a soldering iron and half-finished technical experiments at home, you could be exactly who we are looking for.

**WHAT A REAL PROJECT LOOKS LIKE**

One recent project started with our goods-out system and developed into an end-to-end parcel tracking platform.

It involved:

* Integrating physical GPS trackers into our warehouse dispatch workflow
* Connecting tracker information with shipping-carrier APIs
* Automatically generating and printing return labels and instructions
* Building a customer-facing web interface where clients can monitor consignments in real time on a map
* Developing background services to monitor shipments and identify exceptions
* Creating workflows that allow us to intervene proactively when something does not look right

The engineering does not stop at "does it work?"

Displaying large numbers of live parcel locations also means thinking about the commercial cost of map tiles, API calls, polling frequency and third-party services.

We build with real business constraints in mind: cost, reliability, scalability, API limits, maintainability, performance and operational impact.

*A technically clever solution that costs too much to operate is not a good solution.*

**FROM SENSOR TO DASHBOARD**

Other projects cross the boundary between software and hardware in a different way.

You might build or integrate a sensor for a piece of equipment, then build the software that:

* Collects and stores its readings
* Graphs the data over time
* Allows users to configure warning and alert thresholds
* Generates notifications when readings fall outside normal limits
* Helps the production team understand what is happening

Because we build much of this ourselves, there is scope to work on the entire solution rather than one isolated component.

You may literally build the sensor at one end of the project and the dashboard displaying its data at the other.

**OTHER PROJECTS**

Recent and ongoing work includes:

* **Computer Vision:** Using machine learning to help detect garment-printing defects during production
* **Dimensioning:** ToF sensors for measuring parcels and dimensions
* **Machinery Monitoring:** Proximity and Hall-effect sensors for monitoring equipment
* **Fluid Tracking:** Ultrasonic sensors for monitoring liquid levels
* **Pneumatics:** Pressure transducers for monitoring compressors and pneumatic systems
* **Microcontrollers:** ESP32-based devices and low-power embedded systems
* **Remote Nodes:** Solar and battery-powered outdoor hardware
* **Displays:** E-ink integrations
* **Mobile & Scanning:** Android handhelds with integrated barcode scanners and thermal printers
* **Custom Hardware:** Devices designed around specific production problems
* **Prototyping:** 3D-printed enclosures, brackets and prototype parts
* **Assembly:** Soldering and basic electronics assembly

We have our own 3D printer and soldering equipment, so ideas can go from software prototype to physical device in-house.

You do not need previous commercial embedded, IoT or machine-learning experience.

You do need to be someone who looks at a sensor, microcontroller, camera system or interesting piece of hardware and wonders what you could make it do.

**OUR SOFTWARE STACK**

Our main stack includes:

* C# and .NET
* ASP.NET and ASP.NET Core
* Razor Pages
* Existing ASP.NET Web Forms applications
* SQL Server
* Entity Framework
* HTML, CSS and JavaScript
* Windows desktop applications
* REST APIs and third-party integrations
* Git

You may also work with Android devices, barcode scanners, thermal printers, industrial equipment and other production hardware that integrates with our internal systems.

You do not need to arrive knowing all of this.

We can mentor someone with good technical aptitude and a solid programming foundation.

**AI-FIRST DEVELOPMENT**

We take an AI-first, agentic approach to development, using coding agents as a normal part of our workflow rather than treating AI as simple autocomplete.

We use AI to accelerate implementation, investigate unfamiliar code, prototype ideas, debug problems, refactor systems and work through multi-step development tasks.

Developers are still expected to understand the systems, review the output, recognise when the AI is wrong and take responsibility for the finished result.

*AI makes us faster. It does not remove the requirement to understand what we are building.*

**AUTONOMY**

We are a small team, and there is a lot of scope for autonomy once you understand the systems and the business.

The technical lead sets the overall architecture and standards, but we are more interested in giving you a problem to solve than prescribing every class, screen and implementation detail.

As your experience grows, we expect you to:

* Investigate problems independently
* Suggest better approaches
* Make sensible technical trade-offs
* Think about cost and business impact
* Understand how the software affects the wider operation
* Increasingly own solutions from idea through to production

You will work directly with the technical lead rather than through several layers of project management.

**IT ISN'T ONLY DEVELOPMENT**

Because we are a small technical team, there are no rigid boundaries between software development, support and infrastructure.

The role also includes some:

* General Windows PC and user support
* Printer and scanner troubleshooting
* Application support
* Deployment
* Basic infrastructure work
* DevOps-style tasks
* Investigation when something we have built stops working

We have external MSP support where appropriate, but most normal day-to-day technical issues are handled internally.

If a PC stops working, a label printer misbehaves, an application has a problem or a device you built stops responding, you may be involved in resolving it.

**There is no routine out-of-hours or on-call requirement.**

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

We care more about technical aptitude, curiosity and problem solving than whether you tick every technology box.

You should have:

* Some practical programming or scripting experience
* A methodical approach to troubleshooting
* An interest in how systems work
* The ability to learn unfamiliar technologies
* An interest in hardware, electronics or physical systems
* A willingness to get hands-on rather than treating support or hardware as somebody else's problem

Useful experience includes:

* C# or another object-oriented language
* .NET
* SQL
* Git
* Python or PowerShell
* JavaScript
* REST APIs
* Windows administration
* Networking
* General IT support
* ESP32, Arduino or Raspberry Pi
* Electronics and soldering
* 3D printing or CAD
* Home automation
* IoT projects
* Computer vision or machine learning

*None of these individually is mandatory.*

**LOCATION AND ELIGIBILITY**

This is a primarily on-site role in Ramsgate, Kent, with occasional work at our Margate site.

Applicants must be able to commute reliably to our Ramsgate site, or be relocating before starting the role.

Own transport is beneficial due to occasional travel between sites.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK for this role.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply by email to itjobs@epcc.co.uk.

If you have GitHub repositories, personal projects, electronics builds, scripts, automations or anything else interesting you have made, include those too.

*The cooler and more obscure, the better.*

**RECRUITMENT AGENCIES**

Due to the nature of this role, we are handling recruitment directly and are not inviting applications from recruitment agencies at this time.

**We welcome direct applications from candidates.**

Please do not submit speculative CVs or candidate details without a prior written agreement with EPCC.

Where details are submitted without such an agreement, no recruitment fee will be payable and we reserve the right to contact the candidate directly.

Pay: £29,000.00-£34,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* On-site parking

Work Location: In person
